description: Supplementary evidence for the release gates the frozen-sample runner cannot compute from its own run. G6 reads `lifecycle`; G8 reads `ui`. Both abstain (NOT_RUN) when this file is absent, unreadable, older than 30 days, or missing a required field.

lifecycle.note: Default converter policy. The 6 skips are 2 opt-in release-gate assertions plus 4 environment limits: 2 need SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege and 2 need genuine Microsoft Word.

ui.note: Attested by the project owner on 2026-09-20, accepting automated real-browser evidence for G8. Chrome 135.0.7049.85 drove the live app at all three viewports: role switch, client-side routing to the template list, template detail with the audit timeline visible, the server-enforced role boundary, and the task list. Document-level horizontal overflow is 0 at every viewport after the responsive fix recorded in that directory's before-fix/ baseline. Frontend suite: 17 passed, typecheck and production build pass. Known and accepted residual items: /favicon.ico returns 404, and the selected role is not preserved across a full page reload (client-side routing is unaffected). No human visual acceptance was performed.
